name: LAMBDA
description: LAMBDA is a benchmark for evaluating data efficiency of models on language-conditioned, long-horizon, multi-room, multi-floor, pick-and-place tasks in indoor mobile manipulation robotics. It includes 571 human-collected demonstrations providing realism and diversity in simulated and real-world settings.
reputation: A specialized robotics benchmark for language-conditioned long-horizon manipulation, mainly used in embodied AI research rather than as a broad general benchmark.
notes: Focuses on data efficiency with human-collected demonstrations; evaluates end-to-end and neuro-symbolic methods.
